title: The Trust Gap
status: Picks approved · built from the ElevenLabs take · draft for Samrat

captions.text:
It answered in two seconds.
Did you check it?

Coders used to ask strangers
on forums… and wait hours
for a tick.

But now, more than seven in ten
use AI every day.

So they trust it? Only 16%
trust it with most tasks.

Most trust it only when
they can check the answer.

So the next skill may not be
asking… but *checking*.

Because when it answers
in *two seconds*—

so2026.title: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2026 — AI (30,903 valid responses, fielded 23 Jun – 5 Aug 2026): 73% use coding assistants/agents daily; 48% trust AI when they can easily validate; 16% for most tasks that are not important work decisions
